# Output Files

The variant calling stage generated one compressed VCF file for each sequencing sample.

## Generated Files

| Sample | Output File |
|---------|-------------|
| SRR11603071 | SRR11603071.vcf.gz |
| SRR11603072 | SRR11603072.vcf.gz |
| SRR11603073 | SRR11603073.vcf.gz |
| SRR11603080 | SRR11603080.vcf.gz |

---

## File Description

Each VCF file contains:

- Chromosome
- Genomic Position
- Reference Allele
- Alternate Allele
- Quality Score
- Filter Status
- INFO annotations
- Genotype information

These files served as the input for functional annotation using Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor (VEP).
